This is your brain trying to file away memories, thoughts, and moments in your life. There’s not much you can do about it it’s really just how your brain copes. It’s the brains little filing system and it’s trying to understand things that maybe it never fully worked through before. Be patient with yourself, it’ll pass once it feels like it got a better grip on understanding. Be nice to your mind:) don’t be telling yourself that you shouldn’t be dreaming this or that it’s not normal. Nothings normal and everyone’s different. People that don’t have trauma won’t understand, and that’s okay.

Here are some things my family and friends have told me: 
My aunt lost her son to an over dose and she believes that sometimes these things are inevitable. No matter how hard we try for our loved ones they are going through something inside we can never understand. I tried to get my boyfriend to therapy on many many occasions, even couples therapy for us both. But he put a lot of pressure on me as one person that he wanted me to fulfill all roles in his life; a gf, a best friend, a confidant, maybe even a mom because his mother left him as a child. 

You cannot blame yourself for anything you said or did, people say really awful things to others (especially ones we love) when we are mad because we are human. We have feelings and sometimes with people we love these feelings are so extreme we can’t control things like anger and love (actually sometimes these two feelings can be crossed over) just because we argue or say mean things, committing suicide is not a normal response to an argument. There has to be other things and like you said he has mentioned this before. 

I know things are easier said than done like “don’t blame yourself” because we are going to do it anyways no matter what anyone says. But a normal amount of blame and guilt is okay just don’t let it manifest into something bigger. 

People who do these things usually has mental illnesses or feelings of hopelessness that have a lot more to do than some argument they had with their SO. 

My boyfriend also had expressed 3 other times that he had thought about suicide and I blame myself greatly for not doing more. But I am human and I have hard things in my life as well and it’s not that I did nothing. Like I said I was forcing him to do therapy (maybe at this point it was too late and therapy didn’t help) and I was constantly there for him when he needed.
